parsed.rationale: All five members — `AppleMusicService`, `BandcampService`, `SoundCloudService`, `SpotifyService`, and `YouTubeMusicService` — are `type-alias-object` declarations in the same package (`MusicShareKit`) with identical structural shape (`shared_field_count: 1`, `differing_slots: null`), meaning they are exact structural duplicates that differ only in name. Because they represent distinct music-service domain concepts that share the same shape, the idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a unifying `MusicService` protocol (or PAT) that each concrete type conforms to, rather than maintaining five parallel type-alias objects. This eliminates the duplicated structural boilerplate while preserving the distinct nominal identities required for each service. All five files reside under `Shared/MusicShareKit/Sources/MusicShareKit/Services/`, making consolidation straightforward with no cross-package dependency changes needed.
